errands.name: a warding on the walls
errands.text: pale sigils are chalked on every gate, and the townsfolk sleep easier.

errands.name: rain on the fields
errands.text: a soft rain falls on the fields for three days, and the granaries fill.

errands.name: a scrying of the wilds
errands.text: the mages spend a night over their mirrors and send the council word of places nobody had heard of.

errands.name: a cure for the lanes
errands.text: a mage walks the poor lanes with a censer, and the coughing stops.

terms.name: Slay
terms.text: Kill what lives there and bring back the hoard. The place stays empty longest.

terms.name: Drive off
terms.text: Break them and let them run. Half the fighting and a third of the hoard, and something moves back in sooner.

terms.name: Talk down
terms.text: Send heroes with silver tongues to talk them into leaving. No blood if it works; a fight if it doesn't. Only for foes clever enough to bargain.

terms.name: Rescue
terms.text: Fight in far enough to cut the captives loose, then get them home. The place itself is left standing.

terms.name: Fetch
terms.verb: steal the best of the hoard from
terms.text: Get in, take the best thing in the hoard for the town, get out. The place is left standing.
